name: The Smiths

whyMatters.en: Manchester four-piece formed in 1982. Johnny Marr’s multi-tracked jangle and Morrissey’s literary lyric defined mid-1980s UK indie; The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the peak album citation.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特四人组，1982 年成立。Johnny Marr 的多层 jangle 与 Morrissey 的文学歌词界定 1980 年代中期英国 indie；《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）是峰值专辑引用。

essentialTracks.title: There Is a Light That Never Goes Out

note.zh: Rough Trade 突破单曲；Rickenbacker jangle 与跳拍鼓 intro。

note.zh: 双吉他 vibrato/tremolo 墙；Smiths 最密制作引用。

note.zh: 《The Queen Is Dead》谣曲；男中音叙事下的多层原声。

shortBio.en: Morrissey / Marr indie, 1982–1987. There Is a Light That Never Goes Out is the lasting single.
shortBio.zh: Morrissey / Marr 的 indie，1982–1987。《There Is a Light That Never Goes Out》是长寿单曲。

body.en:
The Smiths formed in Manchester in 1982. Rough Trade singles and five studio albums through Strangeways, Here We Come pair Johnny Marr’s multi-tracked jangle with Morrissey’s baritone and UK-specific references. They stayed on guitar and did not move into synth-pop.

This Charming Man (1983) was the early breakthrough. The Queen Is Dead (1986) and There Is a Light That Never Goes Out are the main later citations. The band split in 1987 with no reunion catalog. Oasis, Blur, and The Stone Roses later cite Marr’s voicings and Morrissey’s first-person lyric separately.
body.zh:
The Smiths 于 1982 年在曼彻斯特成立。Rough Trade 单曲与直至《Strangeways, Here We Come》的五张录音室专辑，把 Johnny Marr 的多层 jangle 与 Morrissey 的男中音、英国本土指涉配对。乐队坚持吉他编制，未转向 synth-pop。

《This Charming Man》（1983）是早期突破。《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）与《There Is a Light That Never Goes Out》是后来主要引用。1987 年解散，无重组目录。Oasis、Blur 与 The Stone Roses 后来分别引用 Marr 的声部与 Morrissey 的第一人称歌词。

title.en: Jangle and literary lyric in mid-80s UK indie
title.zh: 80 年代中期英国 indie 的 jangle 与文学歌词

body.en:
Marr’s Rickenbacker and Tele layers sit under Morrissey’s first-person UK references. That pairing became a central mid-1980s indie sound against the synth-pop mainstream.

The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the album later Britpop acts name most often.
body.zh:
Marr 的 Rickenbacker 与 Tele 叠层托着 Morrissey 的第一人称英国指涉。这套配对成为 1980 年代中期 indie 的核心声音之一，相对 synth-pop 主流。

《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）是后来 Britpop 最常点名的专辑。

body.en:
1982–87 classic four never swaps singers. Breakup ends the catalog; there is no reunion album.

Citation density is high for five studio albums.
body.zh:
1982–87 经典四人不换主唱。解散结束目录；无重组专辑。

五张录音室专的引用密度高。

body.en:
1983 Rough Trade single: skippy drums, bright arpeggios, baritone over a major-key bounce.

Early entry for UK indie guitar radio.
body.zh:
1983 年 Rough Trade 单曲：跳拍鼓、明亮分解和弦、大调弹跳上的男中音。

英国 indie 吉他电台的早期入口。

body.en:
Division of labor is clear: Marr owns multi-guitar voicings and arrangements; Morrissey owns lyric and persona. Rourke’s melodic bass and Joyce’s dry kit keep songs short.

How Soon Is Now? stacks vibrato for density while keeping song form.
body.zh:
分工清楚：Marr 管多吉他声部与编曲；Morrissey 管词与人设。Rourke 的旋律贝斯与 Joyce 的干鼓保持短曲。

《How Soon Is Now?》用 vibrato 堆密度，同时保留歌曲形式。

body.en:
Marr’s production aim for How Soon Is Now? and Morrissey’s absolutist interview lines document method and public posture.

Quotes sit beside the records, not instead of them.
body.zh:
Marr 对《How Soon Is Now?》的制作目标与 Morrissey 的绝对访谈句，记录方法与公开姿态。

引语旁证唱片，不替代唱片。

body.en:
Oasis and Blur inherit Marr’s chord voicings and Morrissey’s first-person UK lyric as separate strands. The Stone Roses take jangle into Madchester tempo.

The Smiths remain a main 1980s hinge into 1990s UK guitar radio.
body.zh:
Oasis 与 Blur 分别继承 Marr 的和弦声部与 Morrissey 的第一人称英国歌词。The Stone Roses 把 jangle 带进 Madchester 速度。

The Smiths 仍是通向 1990 年代英国吉他电台的主要 1980 年代节点。

note.en: Only studio lineup; five albums then split.
note.zh: 唯一录音室阵容；五专后解散。

note.en: Jangle single that fixed an early UK indie guitar sound.
note.zh: 定下早期英国 indie 吉他声音的 jangle 单曲。

note.en: Literary lyric and multi-tracked jangle without synth-pop.
note.zh: 文学歌词与多层 jangle，不做 synth-pop。
